stage1.impression: A competent wide CG render of a long timber-and-concrete bar. It reads as a game or showroom visualisation, not a photograph: the floor is a cold, evenly bright grey slab with hard stool shadows, the stools, chairs, tables and globe lamps repeat in identical rows, and the far end falls into a black void. The multicolour globe is the strongest thing in the frame, but it reads as LED neon hoops, like a nightclub fixture, not as polished cast acrylic. As it stands a design magazine would see a generic, catalogue-furnished bar with a light sculpture in it, not a specific place.

blocking_9: Floor no longer the brightest large surface: aisle floor lum_median under the frame median plus 10, warm (r_median - b_median >= 12), with no hard cold-looking stool shadows
One coherent warm light: the right concrete wall's b_median below its g_median, and the wall no longer cooler than the ceiling
Mother EARF reads as thick polished acrylic discs with glowing edges and visible faces, not neon hoops, and its coloured shadow on the wall reads as a deliberate shape
The altar pair and the back-bar pair read as smoked tinted acrylic at a glance (not white studio monitors), and the altar pair's region sits at lum_median >= 50
The zone at the far end holds detail (no black void at 700-850 x 290-480) and shows life
No visibly identical, evenly spaced rows of stools, chairs and Orb-topped tables; visible props and lived-in disorder on the near tables
Orbs read as smoked acrylic with a frosted glow, not white balls

defects.what: Floor overlit and neutral grey (median 61, r66/g60/b57), with a blotchy slate-like mottle and hard stool shadows. It is brighter than the room and reads as a CG paver texture
The right concrete wall is lit flat and cool (median 74, b74 > g71) against an orange ceiling (r73/b24): two colour temperatures in one room
Mother EARF reads as thin saturated LED hoops with invisible disc faces, like a nightclub wireframe. Its top ring nearly touches the frame edge
The globe's coloured shadow on the wall is a fragmented, hard-edged sliver that reads as a projection artefact
Altar speaker: median 44 (under 45). It reads as a white box with a grey woofer (a studio monitor), with no smoked tint visible
Back-bar speaker in its niche is overlit and neutral (median 125, r127/g124/b123): white batts glare, no tint
Black void right of the altar (median 10.9) where the zone should be
Orbs read as bright white frosted balls (median 121), identical on every table
Identical stools and identical black curved-back chairs in evenly spaced rows: repeated copies of one model
The zinc counter's front edge and top are hot (median 143, p95 231), a bright stripe across the left third
Framed screens on the right wall read as blank grey-violet rectangles with smeared images (denoiser/low emission)

changes.problem: The Domes' downlights spill past the zinc onto the aisle, making the floor the brightest large surface, neutral grey, with hard stool shadows.

evidence.measured: lum_median 61.1 vs frame 33.4; r66 g60 b57; p95 174

change.to: 14.0 W, cone 11.0 deg, aimed to land on the zinc top, with a soft blend (spot blend 0.4)

changes.expected: Pools on the counter; the aisle floor drops to a dim warm grey with soft-edged shadows

changes.problem: Mother EARF's hard spot floods the right concrete wall in a cooler, flatter light than the rest of the room.

evidence.measured: lum_median 73.8, b_median 74 > g_median 71; ceiling r73 b24

change.to: 85 W, cone 18 deg, 2700 K, so the beam lands on the globe and throws its coloured shadow without washing the wall

changes.expected: The wall goes dim warm concrete with one clear coloured shadow pool; the wall's colour matches the room's

changes.problem: The globe's rims glow like LED tubes, so it reads as neon wireframe, and the 25 mm disc faces are invisible.

evidence.measured: p95 133, clip 0.11 % on the rims; disc faces at the background level (median 22)

change.setting: Mother EARF rim glow, and haze
change.to: rim glow 0.012; haze 0.007 /m so the spot's beam and the light through each disc read in the air

changes.expected: Rims read as polished acrylic edges lit by the spot, the tinted faces catch light, and the globe reads as cast acrylic rather than a nightclub fixture

changes.problem: The back-bar pair's niche strip overexposes the white batts, so the smoked speakers read as white monitors.
changes.expected: The tinted cabinet reads over the batts; the niche glows instead of glaring

changes.problem: The altar pair is under-lit and reads as white boxes, and the zone beside it is a black void.

change.setting: the altar spots, and the disc behind the DJ station
change.from: altar 2 x 110.0 W, cone 30 deg; disc 0.06 with a 4.0 W area lamp
change.to: altar 2 x 150 W, cone 24 deg, with the spots raked from above-front so they light the cabinets' faces, not the batts; disc 0.12 with an 8 W area lamp

changes.expected: The altar pair is the brightest thing at the far end, and the zone shows furniture and a glow instead of black

changes.problem: The Orbs read as bright white balls, not smoked acrylic with a frosted liner.

change.setting: each Orb (W, glow), and how rough the frosted acrylic is
change.to: 0.06 W, glow 0.0015; frosted liner roughness up so it diffuses rather than reflecting the spots

changes.expected: The Orbs glow low and warm through a visible smoked shell

changes.problem: Rows of identical stools, chairs and tables read as copies of one model; the room looks staged and empty.

evidence.measured: seven stools and five chairs at near-identical angles and spacing; one glass on the near table

change.setting: the seats' turns and offsets, and props
change.from: seats up to 7 deg / 2.5 cm, two pulled out; 3 rocks, 2 coupes, 1 coat
change.to: seats up to 18 deg / 8 cm, four pulled out, one stool turned to face the aisle; on the near banquette table a half-drunk glass, a record sleeve and a napkin; a second coat over a near chair; a bag on the banquette

changes.expected: Breaks the repetition and gives the near foreground a sign of life

changes.problem: The floor's mottle reads as tiled grey slate pavers rather than honed concrete, and the zinc's front edge is a hot stripe.

evidence.measured: zinc lum_median 143, p95 231; floor blotches at paver scale in [250,560,700,800]

change.setting: the concrete floor's mottle and tone; the zinc's roughness
change.from: tone +/-7 %, honed sealer; zinc as now
change.to: floor tone 15 % darker and warmer, mottle scale doubled (no paver-sized blotches), roughness +/-10 %; zinc roughness up 0.1 so the top's sheen is soft

changes.expected: The floor reads as one poured warm concrete slab; the counter top glows softly instead of glaring

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's discs read thicker, or give the globe visible disc faces through geometry
out_of_scope.why: Its shape, colour and parts are the product's; only its lighting and the acrylic's finish may change

out_of_scope.request: Give the Atmosphere speakers a darker or more visible tint so they don't read as white monitors with exposed woofers
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' colour, batts and parts are fixed; only their lighting can change

out_of_scope.request: Replace the identical stools and curved-back chairs with mixed pieces
out_of_scope.why: The seats are part of the fixed room design; only their placement can change

out_of_scope.request: Pull the camera back or shift the lens to give the globe headroom from the top edge
out_of_scope.why: Allowed (the camera may change), but it moves every region, so it carries no pixel test; worth doing alongside c1 to c8
